request_format: GET query parameters for lists; employee updates accept a field dictionary in JSON or XML.
response_format: Employee listing is JSON with data, meta and _links. The list identifies restricted fields separately.
pagination: page[limit] defaults to 250, maximum 2,500; opaque page[after]/page[before], with _links.next and _links.prev.

request_format: GET query parameters with scoped Bearer authorisation.
response_format: JSON collection array plus pagination for scheduled-event lists.
pagination: count defaults to 20 and permits up to 100; page_token and pagination.next_page/next_page_token.

request_format: JSON resource dictionaries inside a party wrapper for writes; query parameters for reads.
response_format: Lists return a parties array; single-record responses use a party object.
pagination: page and perPage (default 50, maximum 100); follow Link rel=next when present.

request_format: JSON envelope definitions with OAuth Bearer authorisation; account and envelope IDs are path parameters.
response_format: JSON envelope results and recipient status resources; Connect notification format is configured separately.
pagination: The selected operations address one envelope or create one envelope; collection pagination is not assessed.

request_format: JSON document fields for POST and PUT; URL query parameters include JSON-encoded fields and filters.
response_format: Successful resource responses wrap document objects or lists under data.
pagination: limit_start and limit_page_length; default list length 20. Request fields explicitly.

request_format: JSON OData resource bodies; Bearer authorisation; If-Match on customer PATCH.
response_format: Customer operations return JSON resource objects; OData collections use an envelope.
pagination: Server-driven paging applies. Prefer: odata.maxpagesize can request a smaller page; online maximum is 20,000 entities.

request_format: All model calls use POST with a JSON dictionary of named method arguments, including ids/context where applicable.
response_format: The JSON-serialised method result is returned directly; errors use an error object with HTTP 4xx/5xx status.
pagination: For search_read, use the ORM domain, fields, offset and limit arguments. This is model pagination, not a REST next-page URL.

request_format: GET query parameters; POST field payloads follow the selected endpoint reference.
response_format: JSON resource arrays for list calls; write results must be interpreted using the endpoint response and headers.
pagination: cursor=-1; follow x-next-cursor, up to 1,000 records per page.

request_format: JSON bodies for POST/PATCH; page and pageSize query parameters for lists.
response_format: Lists are JSON arrays; individual resources are objects. Successful job PATCH has no response body.
pagination: page is the page number; pageSize defaults to 30 and allows up to 250. Inspect Result-Total, Result-Pages and Result-Count headers.

version: v1 Customers; account/request API version also applies
request_format: Form-encoded parameters for the selected v1 POST endpoint; query parameters for lists.
response_format: Customer objects are JSON. List responses use object=list with data, has_more and url.
pagination: starting_after or ending_before cursor; limit 1–100, default 10; inspect has_more.
